findings.title: Add an automated regression test for the SQL-expression kill switch
findings.body: This security-critical rejection has no accompanying test. In particular, a test should construct an SQL expression while `FlagSqlExpressions` is globally enabled (the state that previously allowed this path) and assert that parsing/command creation is rejected and cannot reach SQL execution. Without this coverage, the redundant unconditional-false toggle logic or the placeholder database implementation can be inadvertently simplified or re-enabled later, reintroducing the RCE/LFI path without CI detecting it.
